answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve a unique computational puzzle, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier scans every submission like an atlas to map identity-bound work, treating any repeat as a fable. Each agent acts as an island of compute, forced to solve puzzles that defy pooling. Evidence of replicated logic triggers immediate exclusion with zero refund.
